Rarity.Builder
Builds Rarity: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Rarity.Builder.build().
Rarity.Value
The documented values; Rarity.Value.value() is the add-on JSON string.
RawConverter
Converts the identifier based creative data of a version to a layout of stacks.
RawGroup
A named group of the bundled creative data.
RawLayout
The creative inventory of the bundled data of one version: per category an ordered list of groups and loose stacks, by identifiers.
RawNode
An element of a raw creative category: a RawGroup or a loose RawStack.
RawStack
A stack of the bundled creative data, described by identifiers only.
RedstoneConductivity
The basic redstone properties of a block.
RedstoneConductivity.Builder
Builds RedstoneConductivity: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by RedstoneConductivity.Builder.build().
RedstoneConnection
Values of redstone_east, redstone_north, redstone_south, redstone_west.
RedstoneProducer
If added to a block, indicates that it produces a redstone signal.
RedstoneProducer.Builder
Builds RedstoneProducer: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by RedstoneProducer.Builder.build().
RedstoneProducer.ConnectedFaces
The documented values; RedstoneProducer.ConnectedFaces.value() is the add-on JSON string.
RedstoneProducer.StronglyPoweredFace
The documented values; RedstoneProducer.StronglyPoweredFace.value() is the add-on JSON string.
RegisteredBlock
A block (type level) inside one palette: its state properties, components and origin, and its states, which carry the runtime ids.
RegisteredBlockState
A block state definition in a compiled palette: the runtime id of a state.
RegisteredItem
An item definition in a compiled palette.
Renames
Identifiers Bedrock renamed, old to new, so content of an older version can be mapped forward to the newest one.
Renames.Split
A legacy item variant that became a type of its own.
RenderOffsets
Deprecated.
retired from the add-on format, still sent for legacy content; will be removed if clients stop honouring it
RenderOffsets.Hand
The offsets of one hand.
RenderOffsets.Offset
A transform; a null part is left out.
RenderOffsets.Preset
The client's built-in render offsets of an armor piece (the legacy render_offsets string).
RenderOffsets.Vec3
Three floats, sent as a list of three.
Repairable
Defines the items that can be used to repair a defined item, and the amount of durability each item restores upon repair.
Repairable.Builder
Builds Repairable: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Repairable.Builder.build().
Repairable.RepairItems
List of repair item entries.
Repairable.RepairItems.Builder
Builds Repairable.RepairItems: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Repairable.RepairItems.Builder.build().
Replaceable
A block with this component can be replaced when another block is placed in the same block position.
Replaceable.Builder
Builds Replaceable: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Replaceable.Builder.build().
ReplacedBy
Names the components that replace a deprecated one: Bedrock's documentation or Bedrock Dedicated Server itself says so (for example "Use minecraft:x instead").
ResolvedItem
An ItemVariant resolved against one palette: what to send to the client.
SeaGrassType
Values of sea_grass_type.
SelectionBox
Defines the area of the block that is selected by the player's cursor (the outline shown when looking at the block).
SelectionBox.Builder
Builds SelectionBox: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by SelectionBox.Builder.build().
SelectionBox.Vec3
An add-on JSON vector [x, y, z].
ServerOnly
Marks a component that Bedrock Dedicated Server accepts in a pack but never sends to clients, in the protocols of the range.
Shooter
Compels an item to shoot projectiles, similarly to a bow or crossbow.
Shooter.Ammunition
A list of ammunition entries that define which items can be used as projectiles for this shooter.
Shooter.Ammunition.Builder
Builds Shooter.Ammunition: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Shooter.Ammunition.Builder.build().
Shooter.Builder
Builds Shooter: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Shooter.Builder.build().

Builds ShouldDespawn: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by ShouldDespawn.Builder.build().

The stacked_by_data component determines whether the same items with different aux values can stack.

Builds StackedByData: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by StackedByData.Builder.build().
StateConditions
Evaluates the Molang conditions of custom block permutations against one block state.
StateValue
A value of an EnumState: implemented by the generated enums in org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.state and by enums of your own for custom string states.
StorageItem

StorageWeightModifier
Specifies the maximum weight limit that a storage item can hold.
StorageWeightModifier.Builder
Builds StorageWeightModifier: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by StorageWeightModifier.Builder.build().
StringState
A string block state without an enum: string properties of custom blocks, and vanilla string states that are newer than the generated BedrockStates (e.g.

Support.Shape

TorchFacingDirection
Values of torch_facing_direction.
TraitStates
The block states traits add.
TraitWire
Encoders of the generated BlockTrait types: the rules of data/model/mappings.json per protocol window, hand transforms by name.
Transformation
The block's translation, rotation and scale with respect to the center of its world position.
Transformation.Builder
Builds Transformation: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Transformation.Builder.build().
Transformation.Vec3

TurtleEggCount

UseModifiers.StartUsing

VanillaContent
Selects which vanilla content exists, configured in Paletter.Builder#vanilla.
VanillaData
All vanilla Bedrock data for one DataVersion.
VanillaItem
A vanilla item entry, as sent in the item registry by BDS.

VersionFallbacks

Values of minecraft:vertical_half.

Wearable
Sets the wearable item component, which allows an item to be worn by a player in a specified equipment slot.
Wearable.Builder
Builds Wearable: defaults applied, required fields and ranges checked by Wearable.Builder.build().
Wearable.Slot
The documented values; Wearable.Slot.value() is the add-on JSON string.
Wire
Value conversions the generated encoders use: add-on JSON values to the NBT type a wire leaf has.
WireContext
What one compilation of components targets: the palette's version (its protocol picks the mapping window), where to report what cannot be expressed, and the registry data transforms resolve descriptors against (whether an item exists, the types of a block's states).
WireContext.Registry
Item and block lookups for descriptors.
WireNode
A mutable NBT compound the component encoders write into by dotted path (minecraft:durability.damage_chance.min).
WireOnlyBlockComponent
Hand-written block components for wire fields Bedrock clients read but add-on JSON cannot set (or no longer can): they have no source in the component model, so they are not generated.
WireOnlyItemComponent
Hand-written item components for wire fields Bedrock clients read but add-on JSON cannot set (or no longer can): they have no source in the component model, so they are not generated.
WireOnlyWire
Encoders of the hand-written WireOnlyItemComponents and WireOnlyBlockComponents, dispatched from the generated ItemWire.
